info.title: VeloGroupsets catalogue API
info.description: Public, read-only build-time JSON files served directly by Cloudflare Workers Static Assets. No Worker execution for successful GET/HEAD asset requests. No authentication or query parameters: download complete collections and filter/search locally. Query strings are ignored. Unknown values remain null; model variants and evidence are preserved. Responses include a catalogue_version revision. Browser max-age is 300 seconds. Production v1 preserves endpoint paths, response envelopes, existing fields and canonical IDs. Additive fields, new records and sourced data corrections are permitted; incompatible contract changes require a new major API namespace. Community APIs are separate.

servers.description: Same origin as the served specification

get.description: Build-time JSON served directly by Cloudflare Workers Static Assets without executing the Worker. Query strings are ignored: no server-side search, filtering or pagination. Collections contain all records in canonical snapshot order. Canonical IDs only. Unknown paths and unsupported methods use the platform asset/fallback behaviour.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag validator for same-origin or non-browser clients. Cross-origin JavaScript should use a normal GET and let browser caching manage validation: the static service does not support OPTIONS preflight.

200.description: Generated catalogue JSON.

ETag.description: Platform-provided entity tag; usable with If-None-Match.

Cache-Control.description: Browsers may reuse the file for five minutes before revalidation.

304.description: Unchanged static asset; no response body.

ETag.description: Platform-provided entity tag; usable with If-None-Match.

Cache-Control.description: Browsers may reuse the file for five minutes before revalidation.

weight_g.description: Positive weight in grams for a compliant identified configuration, or explicit null when no compliant weight is sourced.

weight_excludes_skewers.description: Required for front/rear hubs; weights must exclude skewers.

aliases.description: Reserved previous component IDs and slugs merged into this canonical record.

CatalogueVersion.description: SHA-256 of the canonical public catalogue snapshot. Compare across files to detect different releases.
